name: Claire Hashimoto
source:
Animal Type: Dog
Breed: Labrador Retriever
Hometown: Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada

Easygoing,  considerate, and eager-to-please, she puts her friends (and sometimes delicious food) above all other things. Wants to become a singer, but for now she's stuck with a boring office job.
